description: This Java source file defines the class CachingSignalEnrichmentFacade, which implements the SignalEnrichmentFacade interface. It provides asynchronous methods to retrieve partial information about 'things' by leveraging a cache. The class manages cache lookups, cache updates, and handles different types of signals, including delete events, to optimize the retrieval of enriched signal data in a clustered environment.

classes.name: CachingSignalEnrichmentFacade
classes.description: A final class that manages asynchronous retrieval and caching of partial 'thing' data for signal enrichment, designed as a singleton per node within a cluster.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a CachingSignalEnrichmentFacade with specified cache configuration and cache loader.

methods.name: retrievePartialThing
methods.description: Retrieves a partial 'thing' as a JsonObject based on the given ThingId, field selector, headers, and optional signal, with special handling for deletion events.

methods.name: doRetrievePartialThing
methods.description: Performs the internal logic for retrieving the partial 'thing', including cache lookup and cache update logic, considering the type of signal.

methods.name: doCacheLookup
methods.description: Looks up a cache entry for a given entity ID and headers, returning the cached JsonObject or an empty one.

methods.name: smartUpdateCachedObject
methods.description: Decides whether to update the cache based on the revision of the cached object and incoming event, avoiding unnecessary cache updates.

methods.name: handleNextExpectedThingEvent
methods.description: Handles cache updates when expecting the next revision of a 'thing' based on an event, invalidating cache if necessary, and updating the cache with new data.
